title: Universities of Wisconsin Board of Regents selects Tonjanita Johnson as next UWs president
summary_en: The Universities of Wisconsin Board of Regents selected Dr. Tonjanita (Tonja) L. Johnson as the next UWs President. Johnson is currently Senior Vice Chancellor for Academic and Student Affairs at the University of Alabama System.
